obligations.name: growth_messages_by_engineering_members
obligations.description: Select messages located in #growth whose author also holds a #engineering channel membership, for reviewing which engineering-connected people weighed in on growth topics.
obligations.scope: messages within the #growth channel authored by users who are also #engineering channel members

task_spec.text: Identify the messages in #growth whose authors are also members of #engineering, and report their text and authors.
